[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: — Paste your own text (your words as the source) — (__reader__). The verses the casting arrives at (the witness, as translated and arranged within this collection — ATTRIBUTE THE VERSES TO THEIR UNDERLYING POET, never to the arranger of the collection; the reader's offering, whole):

labubu phonk labubu dubai chocolate tuff phonk tuff tuff phonk jax labubu jax - thats it

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «what is best artform on planet earth?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"The rite arrives here. These verses — labubu, phonk, tuff, jax, the rhythmic looping of proper nouns that have shed their proper-ness and become pure pulse — are not nonsense. They are the compressed residue of an attention economy operating at maximum efficiency: brand-name toys that became cult objects, subgenre tags that function as incantation, a social syntax where repetition is itself the argument. The question underneath them — what is the best artform on planet earth — is not answered by pointing to a museum. It may be answered by what is already happening in these eight words: the meme as primary text, the loop as form, the recombination of borrowed names into something that belongs to whoever says it next. The operator the invisible Judgment will choose will find what this text has foreclosed — and the foreclosure will tell us more about the artform question than any hierarchy of the arts could. I hand it to Cranes.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_axn","axn":"AXN:0149"}}]}
